years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's five years ago

disease_control.evidence: Life is manageable. Not great, but manageable. ... Side effects include frequent infections. Had shingles last year, excruciating. ... Crohn's flared. ... fatigue and joint pain make it nearly impossible.

treatments.evidence: Started triple therapy - prednisone, azathioprine, and mesalamine. Prednisone sent blood sugars through roof. ... Tapered prednisone after two months.

Started triple therapy - prednisone, azathioprine, and mesalamine. ... Azathioprine and mesalamine maintained remission for about a year. ... GI doctor switched approach. Stopped mesalamine, wasn't really helping. Started methotrexate for both conditions.

Started triple therapy - prednisone, azathioprine, and mesalamine. ... Azathioprine and mesalamine maintained remission for about a year. ... GI doctor switched approach. Stopped mesalamine, wasn't really helping.
Started methotrexate for both conditions. Helped joints but Crohn's flared.
Finally approved for Humira. ... Been on Humira two years. Life is manageable. Not great, but manageable. Inject every two weeks.

encounters.evidence: Primary care ran basic tests, all normal except elevated CRP.

Referred to gastroenterologist. ... Colonoscopy revealed severe ileocolonic Crohn's. Started triple therapy - prednisone, azathioprine, and mesalamine. ... Finally agreed to biologics. ... Finally approved for Humira.
Prednisone sent blood sugars through roof. Endocrinologist had to add insulin to my diabetes regimen.
Rheumatologist said it's enteropathic arthritis, related to Crohn's.

status.evidence: Finally approved for Humira. ... Been on Humira two years.

barriers.evidence: Insurance nightmare began. Required documentation of failure of multiple therapies. Appeals process took four months. Meanwhile, suffering. Finally approved for Humira. The co-pay even with insurance - $400 monthly. Thank god for manufacturer assistance program.
